title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: What Do We Do with This Pain? (class #45)

chapters.title: Processing difficult news and finding growth
chapters.about: Responding to tragedy and using challenges for personal development

chapters.title: Resolving conflicting values
chapters.about: The dilemma of a Cohen visiting a hospital and balancing family versus national values

chapters.title: Lessons from Parashah Behaalotekha
chapters.about: The movement of the Aron and the Torah's role in clearing a path

chapters.title: Breaking nature to become supernatural
chapters.about: Using Torah to overcome natural inclinations and live in the present

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses how to process painful life events and challenging dilemmas by looking for opportunities for personal growth and spiritual development. She explores the concept of living above nature by holding multiple values simultaneously and emphasizes the importance of being fully present in the moment to connect with Hashem. The class also connects these themes to the movement of the Aron in Parashah Behaalotekha and the value of honoring the Torah received from one's parents.
questions: How can we find growth in painful or difficult situations?
What does it mean to live a supernatural life above nature?
How do we resolve situations where two important values seem to contradict each other?
Why is it important to be fully present in our daily actions?
How should we view the guidance and Torah we receive from our parents?
